BORYS is a Polish Doom/Doom II and Quake/Quake II map maker. 
He worked with WorldCraft tool to create such Quake maps as [[BlueYard]], CChain1, Metalbox, TheLamp, Oldpalace, Moat,
Abrhplus, Windlift, Froqe, Rzaba2, Outpost and Fragteh1. 


== Trivia ==
Currently works as an architect.
